get_current_version: get the current version and tag from version.txt
get_next_version: compute the next version tuple, string, and tag for a given release type
update_version: update version.txt with a new version tuple
run_release_patch: run the release utility with --release-type patch to bump the patch version
run_release_update: run the release utility with --release-type minor --update-version to bump and save the minor version
